INMF.description: Initial Element Force (INMF). Keyed by element ID; ELEM_TYPE selects the force layout, where TRUSS uses 2 axial forces (i- and j-end) and all other types use 12 forces (6 per end).

ELEM_TYPE.description: Element type that determines the ELEMENT_FORCES layout. Case-insensitive. "TRUSS": axial-only, expects 2 forces. "BEAM", "E-LINK" (elastic link), "G-LINK" (general link): expect 12 forces (6 components at each end).

ELEM_KEY.description: Target element ID to which the initial element force is applied.

ELEMENT_FORCES.description: Initial element forces. [ELEM_TYPE=TRUSS] provide 2 values: [Axial-i, Axial-j]. [ELEM_TYPE=BEAM|E-LINK|G-LINK] provide 12 values: [Axial-i, Shear(y)-i, Shear(z)-i, Torsion-i, Moment(y)-i, Moment(z)-i, Axial-j, Shear(y)-j, Shear(z)-j, Torsion-j, Moment(y)-j, Moment(z)-j]. Non-TRUSS types are hard-rejected when fewer than 12 values are supplied.
